# NoChargingAnimation
An LSPosed module to suppress the charging animation on Unihertz devices.

## Installation
1. Root your device.
2. Install LSPosed.
3. Install NoChargingAnimation from this repository.
4. Enable NoChargingAnimation in LSPosed Manager.
5. Reboot.
6. ???
7. Profit!
